focus: Source/test review of exposure scaling, Reinhard luminance mapping, neutral-axis gamut compression, invalid-signal handling and finite display values. Spectral/Bradford accuracy excluded (w033 scope).

checks.result: Read master directive, all requested startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2 acceptance contract; this review supplies no runtime gate or release-readiness claim.

PreviewSettings validates finite exposure in [-6,6]; PreviewColorTransform uses pow(2, exposureStops) before display mapping. testSceneLinearAdditivityAndExposureStops compares +1 stop at 500 cd against 1000 cd, while retaining 500 lx in the exposed scene. No test execution.

After finite RGB and nonnegative finite adapted-Y guards, luminance is Y/(1+Y), and RGB is divided by the same positive denominator. Zero adapted luminance has an explicit black return. testMatchedWhiteBalanceNeutralizesGrayCard checks expected 0.18/1.18 response followed by sRGB encoding. No test execution.

Signed RGB survives into tone mapping. For each component, t is reduced against upper/lower gamut bounds around luminance; t begins at 1 and stays nonnegative. The final linear values clamp to [0,1] before piecewise sRGB encoding. No concrete hue-axis or finite-value defect identified.

All three input XYZ components require finite nonnegative values. Post-adaptation RGB and luminance require finite values; negative luminance is rejected. Arithmetic after these guards has a positive finite denominator and bounded gamut factor. Tests distinguish off-light black from unsupported active geometry and reject an infinite XYZ component. No test execution.

testExtremeValidSettingsStayInDisplayGamut declares 5 emitter temperatures x 3 white-balance values x 3 exposure values (45 combinations), each asserting finite display RGB in [0,1]. The test file also checks preserved lux under white-balance changes and invalid settings during scene encoding. These are inspected assertions, not observed passing outcomes.

coverage_notes: The inspected test file lacks a dedicated table for negative/NaN/infinite values in each XYZ channel and direct negative-stop equivalence. Implementation guards are present; this is optional regression coverage, not an identified code defect.
No independent evaluation of blackbody spectral approximation or Bradford adaptation accuracy was performed.

conclusion: No actionable defect found in the assigned source/test scope; runtime validation remains unperformed by this worker.
